name: Obby Tower
hook: Climb an obstacle course with checkpoints.
how: Jump across moving platforms, lifts and spinning bars to reach the top. Fall and you go back to your last checkpoint. Everyone climbs the same tower at once.
controls: WASD or arrows and Space, or a stick and a Jump button
uses: Your furthest checkpoint is kept, so you carry on from it next time.
The fastest full climbs from the start.
Bots climb with you, and sometimes fall, until enough people join.
Every climber moves for everyone at once, and the moving platforms run on one shared clock.
ideas: Add lava that rises over time
Add a stage of spinning bars
Give a crown to whoever is highest
